title: Quest tutorials
idea: Before each quest, a new NPC, Hiroko, stands next to Ryuuko and explains that quest type in dialog.

glossary.meaning: One of the four quest games: original (catch the falling kana), dodge, shoot, door (Left or Right).
Hiroko's dialog explaining how one quest type is played. Dialog only, one per quest type; no practice room for now.
A new NPC who stands next to Ryuuko before a quest starts and talks about that quest's tutorial.

features.name: Hiroko
features.whatItDoes: A new NPC standing next to Ryuuko before the quest; talking to her gives the tutorial for that quest type.
details: Stands next to Ryuuko before the run only; gone during play and at the end.
Her talk opens by itself when the quest loads (auto talk) and asks whether the player wants the tutorial (yes / no); no = skip.
The auto question only comes the first time the player meets each quest type.
After that she still stands next to Ryuuko before the run; tapping her plays the tutorial again.

features.name: Per-quest tutorial dialog
features.whatItDoes: Hiroko's lines for each of the four quest types, explaining its rules and controls.
details: 3-5 short lines: the goal, how you win and lose, then the controls.
Controls lines depend on the device: keys on a PC, touch on a phone. Under 768 px screen width counts as a phone.
Her last line points the player to Ryuuko (e.g. "Talk to Ryuuko when you're ready."), also after a no.
In English, voiced with an English version of the hiroko voice.

features.name: Tutorial seen flag
features.whatItDoes: Remembers per account in Supabase which quest types' tutorials the player has been asked about, so the auto question only comes once.
details: Needs a small SQL change, added to docs/SQL-query.md.
Without an account (/Dev, MobileTester) nothing is remembered, so Hiroko asks every time.

features.name: Hiroko English voice
features.whatItDoes: A new English voice entry copied from the existing Japanese 'hiroko' profile (same age, timbre and calm manner).

flows.name: First visit to a quest type
steps: The quest loads; Ryuuko and Hiroko stand in front of the player.
Hiroko's talk opens by itself and asks if the player wants to learn how to play.
Yes: 3-5 lines on the rules, then the controls for this device, ending with 'talk to Ryuuko'.
No: she just says to talk to Ryuuko.
The quest type is marked as seen in Supabase.
The player talks to Ryuuko to start the run; Hiroko is gone during play.

flows.name: Later visit
steps: The quest loads with Hiroko next to Ryuuko; no auto talk.
The player can tap Hiroko to hear the tutorial again, or go straight to Ryuuko.

examples.situation: A player on a phone opens the shoot quest for the first time and says yes.
examples.whatHappens: Hiroko explains: shoot the blocks with the wrong kana and catch the right one, lose HP on a mistake; drag to move, tap or add a second finger to shoot. Then: talk to Ryuuko when you're ready.

examples.situation: The same player opens the shoot quest again a week later on a laptop.
examples.whatHappens: No auto talk; Hiroko stands next to Ryuuko. Tapping her plays the tutorial with keyboard lines (arrow keys / WASD to move, Space to shoot).

examples.situation: A first-time player says no to the door quest tutorial.
examples.whatHappens: Hiroko says to talk to Ryuuko; the door quest is marked as seen.

examples.situation: A tester opens /Dev/QuestDoor without logging in.
examples.whatHappens: Hiroko asks every time, since there is no account to remember it.

leftOut: A separate tutorial room / practice plane (maybe later).
Hiroko during the run or at the end of a quest.

decisions.decision: There is one tutorial for each quest type.
Tutorials are dialog only for now, for all four quests; no separate tutorial room (individual plane).
A new NPC, Hiroko, stands next to Ryuuko before the quest and gives the tutorial.
Skipping: Hiroko asks first whether the player wants the tutorial; saying no skips it.
Hiroko explains both the rules and the controls.
Hiroko's lines are in English and voiced.
Hiroko is in the scene before the run only.
Hiroko's talk opens by itself when the quest loads.
Hiroko asks only the first time per quest type.
Controls are explained per device: keyboard keys on PC, touch on phone.
Hiroko's lines use a new English version of her existing voice profile.
'Tutorial seen' is stored per account in Supabase.
After the first time, tapping Hiroko replays the tutorial.
PC vs phone is told apart by screen width.
Without an account, Hiroko asks every time.
Under 768 px screen width counts as a phone.
Hiroko's last line points the player to Ryuuko, after the tutorial or a no.
